name: L BREAK into program
description: Hack the program and get the password hidden in it.
input_specification: This program has only one test, and it's empty (it doesn't give your program anything to read).
output_specification: Output the password recovered from the program. The password is case sensitive.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
